# Vocabulary: perspective

Primary camera or presentation.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `first-person` | First-person | Camera at the avatar's eyes or cockpit. |
| `third-person` | Third-person | Camera follows an avatar. |
| `top-down-2d` | Top-down / side 2D | Orthographic 2D view from above or the side. |
| `isometric` | Isometric | Fixed-angle 2D or 2.5D projection. |
| `free-3d` | Free 3D camera | Player-controlled camera over a 3D world. |
| `text-ui` | Text / UI | Text, menus, cards, or spreadsheets are the primary view. |
| `device-lcd` | Device LCD | Low-resolution dedicated screen. |
